retainedToolFindings.finding: First restore selector included an ellipsis absent from actual button text.
retainedToolFindings.decision: Corrected selector to actual UI; no product/source change.

retainedToolFindings.finding: Session-long main-screen fingerprint changed independently when phone locked.
retainedToolFindings.decision: Guard owned-app restart against its actual per-operation main fingerprint and reject own package on main display; never manipulate owner main display.

retainedToolFindings.finding: Immediate pidof after app restart returned empty before process launch completed.
retainedToolFindings.decision: Preserved failed attempt and checkpoint; bounded wait for actual PID, then resumed the same interrupted state; actual resume passed.

retainedToolFindings.finding: Initial installation adapter omitted the re import required by retained version primitive.
retainedToolFindings.decision: Fixed adapter before installation; no product change.

retainedToolFindings.finding: Phone entered Dozing/secure keyguard; CDP connection and file selection did not complete.
retainedToolFindings.decision: No locked-screen completion claim. After explicit unlock reply, actual picker selection/restore passed. Owner then explicitly requested USB keep-awake; original0 changed to2, actual USB powered/StayOn true verified.

retainedToolFindings.finding: DocumentsUI accessibility click acknowledgement was not proof that file selection completed.
retainedToolFindings.decision: Used input at observed owned-display bounds after unlock and waited for durable library publication before continuing. Native UI, source/default playback, backup/purge and final original-library result passed.
